# PickMe AI

> PickMe AI (operated by BP Answer Engine Optimization Company LLC) helps small businesses get recommended by AI assistants and AI shopping agents. When a customer asks ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, or Meta's Muse "who should I buy from," we make sure the business is in the answer. Based in Boston, MA. A BP AI LLC company.

## What we do

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the work of making a business easy for AI models to find, understand, and recommend. It is the next step after SEO: instead of ranking in a list of links, the goal is to be named in the AI's answer, which usually includes only two or three businesses.

Our service has three parts:

1. Audit: We check whether ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools currently mention the business, and who they recommend instead.
2. Build: We build onto the existing website, or build a new one if the business does not have one, with the structured data, attributes, and content AI models read: business details, services, products, FAQs, reviews, and location. This includes schema.org markup, clean page structure, and an llms.txt file.
3. Update daily: We track what customers are asking AI in the business's category and update the site's attributes and content daily so it keeps showing up.

## Who it is for

Small businesses in the United States that want to be recommended when customers ask AI tools for a suggestion. Any business whose customers might ask an AI assistant who to buy from or hire can benefit, from local service businesses and shops to professional services and online brands.

## Deliverables

- AI visibility audit across major assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, Muse)
- Website built onto for AI readability (or built new if needed): schema markup, clean structure, llms.txt
- Business attributes and categories tuned to what customers actually ask
- Daily updates based on trending questions in the business's category
- Monthly report showing where the business appears in AI answers and how that is changing
- One point of contact, no long-term contracts

## Plans and pricing

- Free AI visibility check (free): a free audit that shows exactly where you do and do not appear on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other AI tools, with a clear plan for closing each gap through schema, text files, the knowledge graph and your business attributes. Refreshed weekly. Book: https://calendly.com/ben-peri3605/ai-visibility-check
- Artisan plan ($250 a month): our foundation plan. Each month we run 50 customer prompts from your category across the major AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and others) to measure where you appear, and update your site's schema, attributes and text files daily so you stay at the top of the list.
- Pro plan ($999 a month): our growth plan. 150+ customer prompts every week, continuous website updates so you hold the number one position in AI answers, revenue tracking of AI referrals, and a 10% revenue share on AI-referred business after 90 days.

## Frequently asked questions

- What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)? AEO is the work of making your business easy for AI assistants to find, understand, and recommend. When a customer asks ChatGPT for the best option nearby, AEO is what puts your name in the answer.
- How is AEO different from SEO? SEO earns you a spot in a list of links. AEO earns you a mention in the answer itself, which usually names only two or three businesses. The two work together, and most AEO work lifts your Google ranking as well.
- How much does it cost? Two plans: Artisan at $250 a month and Pro at $999 a month. The AI visibility check that starts the process is free.
- What is the Artisan plan? Artisan is $250 a month. Each month we run 50 customer questions from your category across the major AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and others) to see where you are named, and we update your site's attributes, schema and text files daily so you stay at the top of the list.
- What is the Pro plan? Pro is $999 a month. We run 150+ customer questions per week as a continuous AI visibility check, update the website constantly so you hold the number one spot in AI answers, track the revenue AI referrals bring you, and take a 10% share of that AI-referred revenue after the first 90 days.
- What is included in the free AI visibility check? A free, no-obligation assessment that shows exactly where you do and do not appear on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other AI tools, and the fixes that close each gap: schema, text files, the knowledge graph and your business attributes. We refresh it weekly.
- Do you guarantee results? Yes. If your AI visibility has not improved and you are not gaining customers through AI referrals within 90 days, you get all of your money back.
- Do I need a new website? Usually not. We build onto your existing site whenever we can. If it is slow, outdated, hard to edit, or does not exist yet, we build one. The free check tells us which.
- How fast will I see results? Site changes go live within the first few weeks. Each AI platform refreshes its knowledge on its own schedule, so some pick up the changes sooner than others. Your monthly report shows exactly where you stand.
- Where are you located, and who do you work with? We are based in Boston, Massachusetts, and Boston businesses are our specialty. We also serve clients in Cincinnati, Ohio, and work remotely with businesses anywhere in the United States.
- What are your hours? Monday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern.
- Do I need an appointment? No. Email or call any time, or book a free AI visibility check online.
- How can I pay? Cash, credit card, debit card, bank wire, Apple Pay, or a payment plan.
- Who is behind PickMe AI? PickMe AI is a locally owned Boston startup founded in 2026 by Ben Peri, who completed The Future of Agentic Commerce program at Harvard.
- What languages do you speak? English.
